original: The Early Access release of Sentinels of the Multiverse 2 is fully playable and includes all hero, villain, and environment decks from the full core game. The full version is planned to have the following additional major features and content: - Interactive tutorial - Campaign mode - Online multiplayer - Villain Events and Critical Events - First Appearance Hero Variants - Improved music and sound effects - More extensive UI animations & interactions - How to Play & Card Library screens - Steam Achievements & Statistics We plan to roll out features and content in several updates during the Early Access phase. If you see a problem or have a suggestion, please report it when it occurs using the in-game Send Feedback button. Thanks for playing!
